entities.summary: Khalid ibn Al-Walid Stadium is a multi-use stadium located in the city of Homs. It is the third-largest football stadium in Syria and is mostly used for football matches. It serves as the home ground of Al-Karamah SC and Al-Wathba SC and holds around 32,000 spectators.
